item.title: Helm Chart Values
item.description:
The layer5-cloud chart installs the Layer5 Cloud server and, as subcharts from the Ory repository, Kratos and Hydra. The defaults below are those of chart version 0.2.0, which ships with Layer5 Cloud v1.0.278. Run helm show values layer5/layer5-cloud to print the defaults of the version you install. For the install procedure, see Deploy Layer5 Cloud.

How values reach the server 🔗

The chart writes env.* values into one ConfigMap and one Secret, and the server pod reads both as environment variables. Sensitive values go to the Secret. Any change to either rolls the server pods, because the pod template carries a checksum of both.
